project.description:
Surfaces as data. A Surface is a sealed record tree — bounded primitives, transforms, combinators, and an Implicit escape hatch holding an arbitrary expression — that lowers to SupirVast `core` IR. The module's real work is the analysis that comes with the lowering: a surface expression is generally NOT a signed distance field, and sphere-tracing one directly punches holes through it. Lowering therefore tracks a Lipschitz bound per subtree and inserts a gradient normalisation (from a forward-mode symbolic derivative of the IR) exactly where a subtree cannot vouch for itself — so hand-authored SDF scenes lower to what they always did, and only arbitrary implicits pay. See docs/surface-compiler.md.
No Vulkan, no shader composition: this module produces IR and bounds. Composing that into a ray-march fragment is the SDF ShaderComposer's job (staged next).
